notablePrerequisites: Umbral Mantle and Careful Cultivation attached to the same creature you control that does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate the creature with Careful Cultivation and Umbral Mantle attached by tapping it, adding {G}{G}.
Activate the creature by paying at most {2} and untapping it, causing it to get +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.
If Agatha of the Vile Cauldron has power 2 or greater, this combo nets infinite green mana.
